A.rank_rule: minimum M_pool VAL error, with r_y <= r_x; refit chosen rank and evaluate TEST once per declared arm
A.scope: reference-defined scores are inside TRAIN-only POD coordinates; an orthogonal full-FACE completion is reported separately and is never used for selection

D.decision_rule_for_this_run: always UNDERPOWERED_EXPLORATORY with n_test=3; thresholds are recorded for provenance, not used to claim absence
D.increment: dR2 = mean_date(E_linF) - mean_date(E_nonlinear); positive favors the nonlinear arm
D.r_x_grid_reason: SF-scale rule from et_D: only 144 TRAIN rows; r_x=8 already gives 144 real Fourier columns
D.rank_rule: minimum full-phase linear linF VAL error
D.reference_krr_train_convention: et_D reports krrF.tr as the linear-skip TRAIN error; the full KRR TRAIN error is additionally reported as tr_full

field.road_basis: NONE; no road-response basis is read or used

status_before_run: exploratory; three TEST dates are underpowered; no absence-of-nonlinearity claim is licensed

window.nyquist: h=9 is stored once; its sine column is omitted from the real phase design; no zero filling to 24 hours
